join.title: Join Your Family
join.subtitle: Get the invite code from a parent's Kindo app
join.hint:
The code looks like KINDO-LION-3847.
Find it in Parent → Settings → Invite Code.
join.howItWorksText:
1. Parent opens Kindo → Settings → shares their invite code
2. Enter the code on this device
3. Everyone's quests and rewards sync automatically!
